description: Integration, end-to-end workflow testing, and deployment configuration - connect frontend to backend, verify full workflow, add Docker configuration
steps: Create docker-compose.yml at project root with backend and frontend services, proper volume mounts for the knowledge base
Create backend/Dockerfile with Python 3.11 base, requirements installation, uvicorn startup
Create frontend/Dockerfile with Node build stage and nginx serve stage
Update frontend vite.config.ts with proxy configuration to forward /api calls to backend during development
Update backend/app/main.py to serve the frontend build in production (or configure nginx in Docker)
Create backend/tests/test_integration.py with integration tests that test the full workflow: create project -> submit problem -> get AI analysis -> select formulation -> advance through phases

Create a README.md at project root with: project description, architecture overview, setup instructions (local dev and Docker), environment variables documentation, usage guide explaining the research workflow phases
Verify the complete workflow: start both services, create a project, go through problem identification, refinement, research question generation, and document generation
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml is valid and defines both services correctly
Integration tests pass exercising the workflow phases
README.md documents the full setup and usage process
The frontend proxy correctly forwards API requests to the backend in development mode
findings: All 58 backend tests pass (36 existing + 22 new integration tests). All 10 frontend tests pass. Both Docker images (backend and frontend) build successfully. The integration tests mock the AI service at the module-level engine instance to avoid real API calls. The vite proxy was already configured in FEAT-002 for /api and /health routes.
